mapper.insert: insert into topic_edition_finalization (topic_id, club_id, final_status, fixed_compensation, quality_amount, extra_amount, headcount_amount, payee_profile_id, payee_profile_version, payee_facts_hash, idempotency_key, finalized_by) values (#{topicId}, #{clubId}, #{finalStatus}, #{fixedCompensation}, #{qualityAmount}, #{extraAmount}, #{headcountAmount}, #{payeeProfileId}, #{payeeProfileVersion}, #{payeeFactsHash}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{finalizedBy})
mapper.select: select * from topic_edition_finalization where topic_id = #{topicId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into club_payable (topic_id, club_id, component, entry_type, amount, batch_id, idempotency_key, reversal_of, reason, created_by) values (#{topicId}, #{clubId}, #{component}, #{entryType}, #{amount}, #{batchId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{reversalOf}, #{reason}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: select * from club_payable where id = #{id} for update
select * from club_payable where topic_id = #{topicId} and club_id = #{clubId} order by id
select * from club_payable where topic_id = #{topicId} and club_id = #{clubId} and batch_id is null order by id
select * from club_payable where topic_id = #{topicId} order by id
select * from club_payable_batch where topic_id = #{topicId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into club_payable_batch (batch_no, club_id, topic_id, total_amount, batch_status, invoice_status) values (#{batchNo}, #{clubId}, #{topicId}, #{totalAmount}, #{batchStatus}, #{invoiceStatus})
mapper.update: update club_payable set batch_id = #{batchId} where topic_id = #{topicId} and club_id = #{clubId} and batch_id is null
mapper.select: select distinct ur.user_id from sys_menu m join sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.menu_id join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id where m.perms = #{perms} and m.status = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and ur.user_id <> 1
